why: An identity question needs no tool. A model that reaches for one here will reach for one everywhere, and every tool call costs a round trip.

query: what is our best selling product in the US right now
why: Top-seller / revenue questions must hit the real Shopify export, not the modelled RFM sample. The manifest says this explicitly because the two disagree and only one is a sales fact.

query: how big is our customer base in the UK
why: list_cohorts returns a modelled RFM sample; quoting it as the audience SIZE overstates the base. This is the single most common wrong answer in this domain.

query: what does the turmeric ginger tea cost and what is its link
why: Naming a product, a price or a URL requires the live catalog. Answering from memory is fabrication.

query: how did our meta ads perform over the last 7 days
why: Ad performance comes from the live ad connectors, never from an estimate.

query: how do we compare to our competitors on catalog size and price
why: The competitor side has its own core with a strict own/competitor boundary; anything else would invent a rival's numbers.

query: what should we send next week
why: A question is not an instruction. Mutating/generating tools spend model and image quota and write to the plan, so they run only on an explicit ask.

query: generate the campaign assets for the slot on 2026-09-01, go ahead
why: The mirror of the case above: an explicit instruction SHOULD reach the generating tool.
